--- 命令 ---
echo "=== 旧循环诊断 ==="
ps -eo pid,args | grep "[r]emote_ctl" | head -3
echo "pid_file: $(cat /root/.remote_pid 2>/dev/null)"
[ -d /root/asar-sync/.git ] && echo "asar-sync仓库OK" || { echo "asar-sync缺失,中止安装"; exit 0; }
echo "=== 安装v5 ==="
echo "" | base64 -d > /root/remote_ctl_v5.sh
bash -n /root/remote_ctl_v5.sh && echo "v5语法OK" || { echo "v5语法错,中止"; exit 0; }
setsid nohup bash /root/remote_ctl_v5.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "v5已后台启动,12s后接管旧循环"
